brief.title: Outpatient appointment scheduling
business_goals: Enable patients to book, reschedule, and cancel appointments online
Show real-time availability per clinician online
Reduce no-shows, especially for first appointments
Automatically free up slots for cancellations within 24 hours
Flag persistent late-cancellers for reception follow-up
Allow patients to request a specific clinician
Allow patients to book 'next available' for some clinic types
Achieve under 3 seconds to load available slots for any given clinic
Reduce phone line backlog on Monday mornings
Reduce inappropriate A&E visits due to booking difficulties

stakeholders.name: Dr. Fiona Marsh
concerns: Double-bookings happen most weeks with current paper diary system
Patients need online booking, rescheduling, and cancellation
NHS Spine lookup required to confirm NHS number before first appointment
Patient data must stay within the UK (UK GDPR)
Need an audit trail of who viewed which patient record and when (CQC requirement)
Need at least seven years of appointment and attendance history retained

stakeholders.name: Tom Reilly
concerns: Online booking needs to show real-time availability per clinician
Cancellations within 24 hours should free slots automatically
Persistent late-cancellers are a problem and need flagging for follow-up
Project needs to go live before new financial year (April)
Budget capped at £180,000 for this phase

stakeholders.name: Ben Coulson
concerns: Many no-shows, especially for first appointments
System should send SMS and email reminders 48 hours and 2 hours before appointments
Patients should be able to request a specific clinician
System should allow 'next available' booking for some clinic types (e.g., physiotherapy)
Phone lines get backed up on Monday mornings, leading to A&E visits

stakeholders.name: Aisha Patel
concerns: Practice management system is EMIS; appointment data needs two-way sync with EMIS
Targeting under 3 seconds to load available slots, even during peak times

constraints: Must pull patient record from NHS Spine lookup to confirm NHS number before first appointment is confirmed
Cannot have a booking without a verified NHS number
Appointment data needs to sync both ways with EMIS (existing practice management system)
Patient data must stay within the UK (UK GDPR)
Need an audit trail of who viewed which patient record and when
Must retain at least seven years of appointment and attendance history
Must go live before the new financial year starts in April
Budget capped at £180,000 for this phase
Target performance of under 3 seconds to load available slots
out_of_scope: Referrals from GPs (those still come through the existing e-Referral Service process)
open_questions: Who is considered an 'existing patient' for self-service booking, given the NHS Spine lookup requirement for 'first appointments'?
What is the desired process for flagging and following up with persistent late-cancellers?
Which specific clinic types should offer the 'next available' booking option?

requirements.statement: The system shall allow patients to book appointments online.
requirements.evidence: Patients need to be able to book, reschedule, and cancel appointments online.

requirements.statement: The system shall allow patients to reschedule appointments online.
requirements.evidence: Patients need to be able to book, reschedule, and cancel appointments online.

requirements.statement: The system shall allow patients to cancel appointments online.
requirements.evidence: Patients need to be able to book, reschedule, and cancel appointments online.

requirements.statement: The system shall display real-time availability per clinician for online booking.
requirements.evidence: Online booking should show real-time availability per clinician, not just per clinic

requirements.statement: The system shall send an SMS reminder 48 hours before an appointment.
requirements.evidence: Ideally the system sends an SMS and email reminder 48 hours before the appointment, and again 2 hours before.

requirements.statement: The system shall send an email reminder 48 hours before an appointment.
requirements.evidence: Ideally the system sends an SMS and email reminder 48 hours before the appointment, and again 2 hours before.

requirements.statement: The system shall send an SMS reminder 2 hours before an appointment.
requirements.evidence: Ideally the system sends an SMS and email reminder 48 hours before the appointment, and again 2 hours before.

requirements.statement: The system shall send an email reminder 2 hours before an appointment.
requirements.evidence: Ideally the system sends an SMS and email reminder 48 hours before the appointment, and again 2 hours before.

requirements.statement: The system shall integrate with NHS Spine to confirm the NHS number for a patient before their first appointment is confirmed.
requirements.rationale: we can't have a booking without a verified NHS number, that's a hard requirement from the trust.
requirements.evidence: Any patient record has to pull from our NHS Spine lookup to confirm the NHS number before the first appointment is confirmed — we can't have a booking without a verified NHS number, that's a hard requirement from the trust.

requirements.statement: The system shall perform two-way synchronization of appointment data with EMIS.
requirements.evidence: Appointment data needs to sync with EMIS both ways — a booking made online should show in EMIS, and if a clinician blocks time in EMIS, it should disappear from the online slots.

requirements.statement: The system shall automatically free up appointment slots for cancellations made within 24 hours of the appointment time.
requirements.evidence: Cancellations within 24 hours of the appointment should free the slot for another patient automatically

requirements.statement: The system shall flag patients who are persistent late-cancellers for reception follow-up.
requirements.rationale: persistent late-cancellers are a real problem for us.
requirements.evidence: we also want to flag those patients so reception can follow up — persistent late-cancellers are a real problem for us.
assumptions: The definition of 'persistent late-cancellers' will be provided.

requirements.statement: The system shall maintain an audit trail of which user viewed which patient record and when.
requirements.rationale: that's something our last CQC inspection specifically asked about.
requirements.evidence: we need an audit trail of who viewed which patient record and when — that's something our last CQC inspection specifically asked about.

requirements.statement: The system shall allow patients to request a specific clinician when booking an appointment.
requirements.evidence: We'd like patients to be able to request a specific clinician

requirements.statement: The system shall allow patients to book the 'next available' appointment for specified clinic types.
requirements.evidence: for some clinic types like physiotherapy, ideally the system should also let them just book "next available" instead.
assumptions: The specific clinic types that offer 'next available' booking will be defined.

requirements.statement: The system shall load available appointment slots for any given clinic within 3 seconds.
requirements.evidence: we're targeting under 3 seconds to load the available slots for any given clinic, even during the Monday morning rush when everyone's trying to book at once.

requirements.statement: The system shall retain at least seven years of appointment and attendance history.
requirements.rationale: in line with NHS records retention guidance.
requirements.evidence: We need at least seven years of appointment and attendance history retained, in line with NHS records retention guidance.

epics.title: Online Appointment Management
epics.goal: Empower patients to manage their appointments conveniently online.

epics.title: Appointment Reminders & No-Show Reduction
epics.goal: Proactively reduce missed appointments and manage late cancellations.

epics.title: System Integration & Data Compliance
epics.goal: Ensure secure, compliant, and integrated appointment data management.

stories.title: Book New Appointment Online
stories.i_want: to book a new appointment online
stories.so_that: I can schedule my care at my convenience

acceptance_criteria.given: I am logged in and viewing available slots
acceptance_criteria.when: I select an available slot and confirm my booking
acceptance_criteria.then: the appointment is confirmed, I receive an email confirmation, and an in-app notification

acceptance_criteria.given: I am logged in and there are no available slots for my chosen criteria
acceptance_criteria.when: I attempt to book an appointment
acceptance_criteria.then: a message 'No available slots for your criteria' is displayed on the screen

stories.title: Reschedule Appointment Online
stories.i_want: to reschedule an existing appointment online
stories.so_that: I can adjust my schedule without calling the clinic

acceptance_criteria.given: I have an upcoming appointment and I am logged in
acceptance_criteria.when: I select to reschedule and choose a new available slot
acceptance_criteria.then: my original appointment is cancelled, the new appointment is confirmed, and I receive an email confirmation for the new appointment

acceptance_criteria.given: I have an upcoming appointment and no suitable new slots are available
acceptance_criteria.when: I attempt to reschedule
acceptance_criteria.then: a message 'No suitable slots are available for rescheduling' is displayed on the screen

stories.title: Cancel Appointment Online
stories.i_want: to cancel an existing appointment online
stories.so_that: I can free up the slot for other patients and avoid a no-show

acceptance_criteria.given: I have an upcoming appointment and I am logged in
acceptance_criteria.when: I select to cancel my appointment and confirm
acceptance_criteria.then: my appointment is cancelled, and I receive an email confirmation of the cancellation

acceptance_criteria.given: I have an upcoming appointment and I am logged in
acceptance_criteria.when: I view my upcoming appointments
acceptance_criteria.then: a 'Cancel Appointment' button is displayed for my upcoming appointment

stories.title: Display Real-time Clinician Availability
stories.i_want: to see real-time availability per clinician
stories.so_that: I can choose a suitable time and clinician for my appointment

acceptance_criteria.given: I am searching for an appointment
acceptance_criteria.when: I select a clinician
acceptance_criteria.then: the system displays all their currently available slots in real-time

acceptance_criteria.given: I am searching for an appointment
acceptance_criteria.when: I select a clinician who has no current availability
acceptance_criteria.then: the system displays "No availability" for that clinician

stories.title: Request Specific Clinician
stories.i_want: to request a specific clinician when booking
stories.so_that: I can continue care with a familiar provider

acceptance_criteria.given: I am booking an appointment
acceptance_criteria.when: I select a specific clinician from the available list
acceptance_criteria.then: only that clinician's available slots are displayed

acceptance_criteria.given: I am booking an appointment
acceptance_criteria.when: I search for a clinician not available for online booking
acceptance_criteria.then: the system indicates the clinician is not available for selection

stories.title: Book Next Available Appointment
stories.i_want: to book the 'next available' appointment for certain clinic types
stories.so_that: I can be seen as soon as possible

acceptance_criteria.given: I am booking an appointment for a specified clinic type (e.g., GP)
acceptance_criteria.when: I select the 'next available' option
acceptance_criteria.then: the system displays the earliest available slot across all relevant clinicians

acceptance_criteria.given: I am booking an appointment for a clinic type not supporting 'next available'
acceptance_criteria.when: I attempt to select the 'next available' option
acceptance_criteria.then: the 'next available' option is not displayed or is disabled

stories.title: Fast Loading of Available Slots
stories.i_want: available appointment slots to load quickly
stories.so_that: I can efficiently find and book an appointment

acceptance_criteria.given: I am on the appointment booking page
acceptance_criteria.when: I select a clinic to view available slots
acceptance_criteria.then: the available slots are displayed within 3 seconds

acceptance_criteria.given: I am on the appointment booking page with a slow network connection
acceptance_criteria.when: I select a clinic to view available slots
acceptance_criteria.then: a loading indicator is displayed while slots are retrieved

stories.title: SMS Reminder 48 Hours
stories.i_want: to receive an SMS reminder 48 hours before my appointment
stories.so_that: I can remember to attend or reschedule

acceptance_criteria.given: I have an upcoming appointment and my phone number is registered
acceptance_criteria.when: it is exactly 48 hours before my appointment
acceptance_criteria.then: I receive an SMS reminder stating 'Your appointment with [Clinician Name] is on [Date] at [Time]. Reply CANCEL to cancel.'

acceptance_criteria.given: I have opted out of SMS reminders
acceptance_criteria.when: it is 48 hours before my appointment
acceptance_criteria.then: I do not receive an SMS reminder

stories.title: Email Reminder 48 Hours
stories.i_want: to receive an email reminder 48 hours before my appointment
stories.so_that: I have an additional prompt to remember my appointment

acceptance_criteria.given: I have an upcoming appointment and my email is registered
acceptance_criteria.when: it is exactly 48 hours before my appointment
acceptance_criteria.then: I receive an email with the subject 'Appointment Reminder' and body containing 'Your appointment with [Clinician Name] is on [Date] at [Time].'

acceptance_criteria.given: I have opted out of email reminders
acceptance_criteria.when: it is 48 hours before my appointment
acceptance_criteria.then: I do not receive an email reminder

stories.title: SMS Reminder 2 Hours
stories.i_want: to receive an SMS reminder 2 hours before my appointment
stories.so_that: I have a final reminder before I need to leave

acceptance_criteria.given: I have an upcoming appointment and my phone number is registered
acceptance_criteria.when: it is exactly 2 hours before my appointment
acceptance_criteria.then: I receive an SMS reminder stating 'Your appointment with [Clinician Name] is in 2 hours on [Date] at [Time].'

acceptance_criteria.given: my appointment was cancelled less than 2 hours before the start time
acceptance_criteria.when: it is 2 hours before the original appointment time
acceptance_criteria.then: I do not receive an SMS reminder

stories.title: Email Reminder 2 Hours
stories.i_want: to receive an email reminder 2 hours before my appointment
stories.so_that: I have a final digital reminder

acceptance_criteria.given: I have an upcoming appointment and my email is registered
acceptance_criteria.when: it is exactly 2 hours before my appointment
acceptance_criteria.then: I receive an email with the subject 'Final Appointment Reminder' and body containing 'Your appointment with [Clinician Name] is in 2 hours on [Date] at [Time].'

acceptance_criteria.given: my appointment was rescheduled to a different day less than 2 hours before the original start time
acceptance_criteria.when: it is 2 hours before the original appointment time
acceptance_criteria.then: I do not receive an email reminder for the original slot

stories.title: Auto-Free Up Cancellation Slots
stories.i_want: appointment slots to be automatically freed up for cancellations made within 24 hours

acceptance_criteria.given: a patient cancels an appointment 12 hours before the scheduled time
acceptance_criteria.when: the cancellation is processed
acceptance_criteria.then: the appointment slot is marked as available for rebooking

acceptance_criteria.given: a patient cancels an appointment exactly 24 hours before the scheduled time
acceptance_criteria.when: the cancellation is processed
acceptance_criteria.then: the appointment slot is marked as available for rebooking

stories.title: Flag Persistent Late-Cancellers
stories.i_want: patients who are persistent late-cancellers to be flagged
stories.so_that: reception can follow up and manage their booking behavior

acceptance_criteria.given: a patient has 3 late cancellations (within 24 hours) or no-shows within a 6-month period
acceptance_criteria.when: the third late cancellation or no-show is recorded
acceptance_criteria.then: the patient's record is flagged as a "persistent late-canceller"

acceptance_criteria.given: a patient is flagged as a "persistent late-canceller"
acceptance_criteria.when: a reception user views their patient record
acceptance_criteria.then: a clear visual indicator of their flag is displayed

stories.title: NHS Spine NHS Number Confirmation
stories.i_want: the system to confirm a patient's NHS number via NHS Spine for their first appointment
stories.so_that: patient identity is verified and records are accurate

acceptance_criteria.given: a new patient attempts to book their first appointment
acceptance_criteria.when: the patient provides their details including NHS number
acceptance_criteria.then: the system queries NHS Spine to confirm the NHS number and displays a confirmation that the NHS number is verified, allowing the appointment to be confirmed

acceptance_criteria.given: a new patient provides an invalid NHS number during their first appointment booking
acceptance_criteria.when: the system queries NHS Spine
acceptance_criteria.then: the appointment booking is halted and the patient is prompted to correct their NHS number or contact reception

stories.title: Synchronize Online Appointment Creation to EMIS
stories.i_want: new online appointments to be created in EMIS
stories.so_that: EMIS records are up-to-date with patient bookings

acceptance_criteria.given: a new appointment is booked and confirmed in the online system
acceptance_criteria.when: the appointment is confirmed
acceptance_criteria.then: the appointment details are created in EMIS within 5 minutes

stories.notes: Split from original S-015 to focus on one aspect of two-way sync.

stories.title: Synchronize EMIS Appointment Cancellations to Online System
stories.i_want: appointment cancellations made in EMIS to be reflected online
stories.so_that: the online system shows accurate availability and patient records

acceptance_criteria.given: an appointment is cancelled in EMIS
acceptance_criteria.when: the cancellation is saved in EMIS
acceptance_criteria.then: the appointment is marked as cancelled in the online system within 5 minutes

stories.notes: New story split from original S-015 to focus on one aspect of two-way sync.

stories.title: Handle EMIS Synchronization Failures
stories.i_want: the system to manage failures during EMIS synchronization
stories.so_that: no appointment data is lost and issues can be resolved

acceptance_criteria.given: the EMIS system is temporarily unavailable when an online appointment is booked
acceptance_criteria.when: the online system attempts to synchronize the new appointment
acceptance_criteria.then: the online system queues the update and retries synchronization every 15 minutes for up to 24 hours

acceptance_criteria.given: an EMIS synchronization attempt fails due to data mismatch
acceptance_criteria.when: the system detects a data mismatch during synchronization
acceptance_criteria.then: an alert is sent to the system administrator and the specific record is flagged for manual review

stories.notes: New story split from original S-015 to focus on error handling for two-way sync.

issues: AC1.then could be more specific about the content of the email confirmation and in-app notification.
reviews.fix_instructions: AC1.then: Specify the key information included in the email confirmation and in-app notification.

issues: AC1.then could be more specific about the content of the email confirmation for the new appointment.
reviews.fix_instructions: AC1.then: Specify the key information included in the email confirmation for the new appointment.

issues: AC2 is prescriptive about a UI element ("Cancel Appointment button"). The story is about the ability to cancel, not the specific UI for it.
reviews.fix_instructions: AC2: Rephrase to focus on the availability of the cancellation action rather than the specific UI element, e.g., "the option to cancel the appointment is available for selection."

issues: AC2 describes a UI/UX implementation detail (loading indicator) rather than directly testing the performance requirement (loading within 3 seconds). The requirement R-016 is purely about the speed of loading.
reviews.fix_instructions: AC2: Rephrase to focus on a measurable aspect of performance or remove if it's a separate UX story. For example, "the system remains responsive during slot retrieval." Or, consider moving the loading indicator to a separate UX story.

issues: AC2 is prescriptive about a UI element ("clear visual indicator"). The story is about flagging, not the specific UI for displaying the flag.
reviews.fix_instructions: AC2: Rephrase to focus on the flag being accessible or visible to reception, rather than prescribing a "visual indicator." For example, "the patient's flag status is clearly visible to a reception user viewing their record."

gaps.description: While UK GDPR is mentioned as a constraint and data residency is noted, there are no explicit security requirements (e.g., data encryption, robust access control, vulnerability management) for handling sensitive patient data, which is critical for a healthcare system.
gaps.suggested_question: Given the sensitive nature of patient data and UK GDPR requirements, what specific security measures (e.g., encryption, access controls, vulnerability testing) do we need to define for the system?

gaps.description: As a public-facing NHS system, there is no mention of accessibility requirements (e.g., WCAG compliance) to ensure the system is usable by all patients, including those with disabilities.
gaps.suggested_question: For a public-facing NHS system, what accessibility standards (e.g., WCAG) must the online booking system meet to ensure it's usable by all patients?

gaps.description: Requirement R-012 refers to 'persistent late-cancellers' but does not define what 'persistent' means (e.g., number of late cancellations, timeframe) or what constitutes a 'late-cancellation'.
gaps.suggested_question: How do we define 'persistent' for late-cancellers (e.g., how many late cancellations within what period) and what is considered a 'late-cancellation'?

gaps.description: The brief raises an open question about who is considered an 'existing patient' for self-service booking, which impacts the application of the NHS Spine lookup requirement for 'first appointments'. This definition is crucial for the booking flow.
gaps.suggested_question: How do we define an 'existing patient' for online booking purposes, especially in relation to the NHS Spine lookup for first appointments?

gaps.description: Requirement R-015 allows booking 'next available' for 'specified clinic types,' but these types are not specified, leaving the scope unclear.
gaps.suggested_question: Which specific clinic types should offer the 'next available' booking option?

gaps.description: The project directly impacts the daily workflows of front-line clinical staff (doctors, nurses) and reception staff who manage appointments, handle patient queries, and follow up on cancellations. Their specific concerns and needs are not explicitly captured.
gaps.suggested_question: Have we engaged with front-line reception staff and clinicians to understand their specific needs and concerns regarding the new online booking system and its impact on their daily workflows?

gaps.coverage_note: The backlog provides good coverage for the core functional requirements of online booking, rescheduling, and cancellation, as well as key integrations and performance targets. The system also addresses important business goals like reducing no-shows through reminders and managing late-cancellers. However, there are some critical non-functional areas, particularly around comprehensive security and accessibility for a public-facing NHS system, that need further definition. Additionally, several requirements contain ambiguities that require clarification to ensure a shared understanding of scope and implementation details. Finally, ensuring the perspective of the direct users of the system (reception and clinical staff) is fully captured would strengthen the project.
